summary: Hand-authored column-aware row parser covering the four distinct report layouts, with per-layout numeric-field arity.
reason: CDC changed the report's column set across vintages: equity 2025 carries 4 numeric columns, equity 2024 carries 6, the funds part carries 1, and the debt part is variable at 1-3 and can only be validated by range. A single positional parser silently mis-assigns columns across vintages, which is the exact failure that would put a percentage into a capital field. splitRowTokens also repairs the 'LISTED-' concatenation the PDF text layer produces, normStatus folds UN-LISTED onto UNLISTED, parseCell treats a bare '-' as ZERO (it is a real zero in these reports, not a missing value) and decodes parenthesised negatives defensively, and dateAmbiguous FLAGS rather than guesses numeric dates that are valid as both DD/MM and MM/DD.
validated_outcome: 0 invariant violations across 29,060 rows once the audit compared the report's own percentage column against its own share and capital columns (an earlier hand-written regex had compared capital against percentage and produced 154 false violations).
